title: MigrateRight
tagline: Case study: SAP ECC to S/4HANA customer, vendor and product master migration on real public data
description: Migrating a Brazilian retailer's customer and vendor master (Olist) and a UK retailer's product master (Online Retail II) from legacy ECC-style extracts to S/4HANA Business Partner and product master: profiling, YAML rules with quarantine, address standardisation against geolocation data, dedup with survivorship, load to PostgreSQL/SQLite and Excel + Streamlit reconciliation for sign-off.

data.name: Brazilian E-Commerce Public Dataset by Olist (Kaggle olistbr/brazilian-ecommerce)
data.use: real customers, sellers and geolocation address reference

data.name: Online Retail II (UCI ML Repository id 502 / Kaggle mashlyn/online-retail-ii-uci)
